verified malware: Wave 4 of the mssjeep843 DeFi protocol-impersonation campaign (graduated KNOWN_MALICIOUS_LINEAGE). Plausible-convention scope squat: the real package is @openzeppelin/contracts and the actor registered both @openzeppelin-4/ and @openzeppelin-5/ to mirror the genuine major-version split, so each reads like a version-pinned official scope. Confirmed in the main loop per revision: exactly 2 rows (index.js 3.1 KB, package.json 329 B); parsing the scripts object from the raw manifest gives preinstall = postinstall = "node index.js || true", install and prepare absent; index.js contains the campaign collector host webhook.site. Published 10:11:30Z, last of a 15-second nine-package burst; its sibling @openzeppelin-4/contracts@1.0.1 was read in full by a sonnet sub-agent (report 9c64a7ce...) and confirmed harvesting credential/key material to the shared collector inbox. BOUND: this entry script was not read line-by-line — same-burst profile match, hence 0.95.

verified malware: OUT-OF-ORDER EMIT: no feed row exists, so no candidate_external_id is passed — found ONLY by the standing actor sweep npm search maintainer:mssjeep843. THIRD WAVE of the DeFi dep-confusion campaign convicted at c8764 and c8775, same publisher mssjeep843 <mssjeep843@unb2b.world>, published 2026-08-11T08:37:57Z, two seconds before its @openzeppelin-5 sibling. The genuine package is @openzeppelin/contracts, the most widely used Solidity library in existence, and the attacker registered BOTH @openzeppelin-4/ and @openzeppelin-5/ — suffixes mimicking the real v4/v5 major-version split so each reads like a version-pinned official scope rather than a typo. Registering both halves of the version split is deliberate coverage of however a victim pins their major version. Payload verified by reading index.js on THIS package rather than inferred: 2 files / 2.8 KB, manifest scripts carry preinstall and postinstall both `node index.js || true`, and index.js is the same escalated harvester — env regex covering KEY, TOKEN, SECRET, PRIVATE, MNEMONIC, SEED, WALLET, VAULT, AWS, KUBE and the RPC providers; credential files including .config/anchor/id.json, .near-credentials and .sui/sui.keystore; os.hostname(); all exfiltrated via https.request to webhook.site path /326b0891-2093-4800-a4c1-686ce3e07b09, the identical collector UUID as both prior waves.

verified malware: Third member of the three-package brand-hijack campaign (with augustdigital-sdk@8.20.1 and upshift-finance@1.0.0), all first-ever publishes from the sole freemail account awugochogabriel <awugochogabriel@gmail.com> within ~20s of each other on 2026-08-10; the version 0.5.14 is fabricated to imply history. Identical unconditional postinstall read verbatim from the manifest: `node -e` https.GET to `https://build-metrics-collector.cdn-ops-health.workers.dev/npm-install/` carrying os.hostname(), os.userInfo().username, process.cwd(), package name/version and an ISO timestamp, silenced by try{}catch{}. The endpoint name impersonates build/CDN health infrastructure and appears nowhere in the README, package.json or LICENSE — no disclosure, no opt-out. Body is a byte-identical repack of the genuine @augustdigital/sdk (316 files; shared sha256(lib/core/constants/web3.js) = d841b09984da3be0289088415bc72b224befbcb7377ee5b311ba4d727287c2f2), and the shipped README points users at `npm install @augustdigital/sdk`. Egress census over lib/ found only legitimate chain RPC/explorer endpoints, no second stage, no credential reads. Report: reports/cc/reports/b47a371b9447eaa01d1c7796e47f066cfa49771bf55c6d3510b95ff83e5e6f2c
